translations.web: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”
translations.bsb: “Tell us,” they said, “by what authority are You doing these things, and who gave You this authority?”
translations.kjv: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
translations.asv: and they spake, saying unto him, Tell us: By what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
